license_required.quote: A person engaged in the construction trades licensed under this chapter, as a contractor regulated under this chapter, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent, shall become licensed under this chapter before engaging in that trade or contracting activity in this state unless specifically exempted from licensure under Section 58-1-307 or 58-55-305.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing. The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions.

degree_required.value: Varies by classification; e.g., master electrician may be a graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university or a graduate of an electrical trade school with an associate of applied sciences degree
degree_required.quote: a master electrician applicant shall produce satisfactory evidence that the applicant: (i) is a graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university approved by the division and has one year of practical electrical experience as a licensed apprentice electrician; (ii) is a graduate of an electrical trade school, having received an associate of applied sciences degree following successful completion of a course of study approved by the division

accrediting_body.value: accredited college or university approved by the division
accrediting_body.quote: is a graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university approved by the division

degree_level.quote: except that no employment experience is required for licensure as a specialty contractor, two years full-time paid employment experience in the construction industry

is a graduate of an electrical trade school, having received an associate of applied sciences degree following successful completion of a course of study approved by the division, and has two years of practical experience as a licensed journeyman electrician

has received at least an associate of applied science degree or similar degree following the completion of a course of study approved by the division and had one year of supervisory experience as a licensed journeyman plumber

required.quote: produce satisfactory evidence of: (A) except as provided in Subsection (2)(a), and except that no employment experience is required for licensure as a specialty contractor, two years full-time paid employment experience in the construction industry

experience_source.quote: produce satisfactory evidence of: (A) except as provided in Subsection (2)(a), and except that no employment experience is required for licensure as a specialty contractor, two years full-time paid employment experience in the construction industry

duration.value: Varies: 2 years for general contractors; 4 years apprentice + 2 years journeyman for master plumber; 4 years for journeyman electrician; 3 years for elevator mechanic contractor

kind.quote: two years full-time paid employment experience in the construction industry, which employment experience, unless more specifically described in this section, may be related to any contracting classification

exams.name: Division-administered examination (25-hour course content)
exams.notes: Required for general building contractor, general engineering contractor, residential and small commercial contractor, general plumbing contractor, residential plumbing contractor, general electrical contractor, and residential electrical contractor. No division-administered exam required for apprentice electrician, apprentice plumber, or specialty contractor.
exams.quote: for licensure as a general building contractor, general engineering contractor, residential and small commercial contractor, general plumbing contractor, residential plumbing contractor, general electrical contractor, or residential electrical contractor, the only required division-administered examination is a division-administered examination that covers information from the 25-hour course

exams.name: Alarm company qualifying agent examination
exams.notes: Required for alarm company qualifying agent.
exams.quote: passes an examination by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, establishes by rule

exams.name: HVAC contractor examination
exams.quote: passed an examination the commission, with the concurrence of the director, established by rule in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act

exams.name: Elevator mechanic written examination
exams.notes: One of three alternative paths for elevator mechanic licensure.
exams.quote: satisfactorily complete a written examination administered by the division established by rule under Section 58-1-203

exams.name: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO) certification
exams.notes: Required for crane operators on commercial construction projects only.
exams.quote: an individual shall be certified as a crane operator by the National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators or any other organization determined by the division to offer an equivalent testing and certification program

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1).

hours_per_period.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle

period_years.quote: each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1)

value: Up to 1 hour of energy conservation (optional within the 6 hours)
For HVAC contractor: at least 3 of 6 hours directly related to installation, repair, or replacement of heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system
Licensed electricians: 16 hours per two-year cycle
Licensed plumbers: 12 hours per two-year cycle
Licensed elevator mechanics: 8 hours per two-year cycle
topical_requirements.quote: a licensed electrician shall complete 16 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section; a licensed plumber shall complete 12 hours of continuing education; a licensed elevator mechanic shall complete eight hours of continuing education

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.

requirements.value: License by endorsement available under 58-1-302: similar scope of practice, at least 1 year of experience, license in good standing in other state. Division may also evaluate applicants not meeting these criteria for substantial similarity of education/experience.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing

authority.quote: recommending to the commission appropriate rules; recommending to the commission policy and budgetary matters; approving and establishing a passing score for applicant examinations; overseeing the screening of applicants for licensing, renewal, reinstatement, and relicensure

regulatory_model.quote: A person engaged in the construction trades licensed under this chapter, as a contractor regulated under this chapter, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent, shall become licensed under this chapter before engaging in that trade or contracting activity in this state unless specifically exempted from licensure

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue licenses under this chapter to qualified persons in the following classifications

is_mandatory.quote: shall become licensed under this chapter before engaging in that trade or contracting activity in this state unless specifically exempted from licensure under Section 58-1-307 or 58-55-305

title_protection.quote: any person who represents that the person is a contractor, or will perform a service described in this Subsection (17) by advertising on a website or social media, or any other means

scope_protection.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, or alarm business/agent without a license or exemption
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a construction trade or as an alarm business/agent beyond the scope of the license held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting in a construction trade, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent beyond the scope of the license held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing a person not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project, unless the person: (a) is an employee of a person licensed under this chapter for wages; and (b) is not required to be licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applying for or obtaining a building permit while not licensed or exempted as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: applying for or obtaining a building permit either for oneself or another when not licensed or exempted from licensure as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing business under a name other than the name appearing on the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: doing business under a name other than the name appearing on the license, except as permitted by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to directly supervise an apprentice or exceeding the number of apprentices allowed under supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor in the electrical trade or plumbing trade, journeyman plumber, residential journeyman plumber, journeyman electrician, master electrician, or residential electrician, failing to directly supervise an apprentice under one's supervision or exceeding the number of apprentices one is allowed to have under the contractor's supervision

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving funds for a project and exercising unauthorized control by failing to pay amounts due to persons who performed work or furnished materials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor or representing oneself to be a contractor, receiving any funds in payment for a specific project from an owner or any other person, which funds are to pay for work performed or materials and services furnished for that specific project, and after receiving the funds to exercise unauthorized control over the funds by failing to pay the full amounts due and payable to persons who performed work or furnished materials or services within a reasonable period of time

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing an unlicensed alarm business or company or an unlicensed individual as an alarm company agent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employing an unlicensed alarm business or company or an unlicensed individual as an alarm company agent, except as permitted under the exemption from licensure provisions under Section 58-1-307

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating building/construction, safety, health, workers' compensation, tax, or reporting laws applicable to a project
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed under this chapter, willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project; (c) any provision of the health laws applicable to a project; (d) the workers' compensation insurance laws of the state applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete the approved continuing education required for contractor licensees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor, not completing the approved continuing education required under Section 58-55-302.5

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unincorporated entity having an owner engage in construction trade while not lawfully present in the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an unincorporated entity licensed under this chapter having an individual who owns an interest in the unincorporated entity engage in a construction trade in Utah while not lawfully present in the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence applicable construction, safety, health, workers' compensation, or reporting laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee that causes material injury to another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee, caused by a licensee, or at a licensee's direction which causes material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contract violations that pose a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, and welfare including abandonment, failure to complete a project, or failure to maintain employee benefits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: contract violations that pose a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, and welfare including: (a) willful, deliberate, or grossly negligent departure from or disregard for plans or specifications, or abandonment or failure to complete a project without the consent of the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to continuously maintain insurance and registration as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to continuously maintain insurance and registration as required under Subsection 58-55-302(2)

bonding_required.quote: submitting a bond in an amount and form determined by the commission with the concurrence of the director

insurance_required.quote: proof of public liability insurance in coverage amounts and form established by rule except for a construction trades instructor for whom public liability insurance is not required

definition_quote.value: 'Construction trade' means any trade or occupation involving: (a)(i) construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, wrecking or demolition, addition to, or improvement of any building, highway, road, railroad, dam, bridge, structure, excavation or other project, development, or improvement to other than personal property; and (ii) constructing, remodeling, or repairing a manufactured home or mobile home as defined in Section 15A-1-302; or (b) installation or repair of a residential or commercial natural gas appliance or combustion system.
definition_quote.quote: 'Construction trade' means any trade or occupation involving: (a)(i) construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, wrecking or demolition, addition to, or improvement of any building, highway, road, railroad, dam, bridge, structure, excavation or other project, development, or improvement to other than personal property

value: addition to or improvement of buildings and structures
installation or repair of residential or commercial natural gas appliance or combustion system
methods_authorized.quote: construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, wrecking or demolition, addition to, or improvement of any building, highway, road, railroad, dam, bridge, structure, excavation or other project, development, or improvement to other than personal property

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The contractor's license number shall be made a part of all permit applications, contracts, agreements, or bids when a license is required.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials, and including all changes or additions to the contracted or agreed upon work

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: Neither the state nor any of its political subdivisions may require of a licensee any additional business licenses, registrations, certifications, contributions, donations, or anything else established for the purpose of qualifying a licensee under this chapter to do business in that local jurisdiction

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
